title_en: Psychology Made Simple (3/20): The Bell Rings, the Dog Drools
note_en: The title 铃声一响，狗就流口水 uses 一…就…: "as soon as A, B." English needs a conjunction ("as soon as," "the moment"), but Chinese simply puts 一 before the first verb and 就 before the second, with no linking word between the clauses. Compare 它一听到铃声就开始流口水 "as soon as he heard the bell, he started to drool."
